test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average of 7 numbers is 10.8. If the average of the first three be 10.5 and that of the last three is 11.4, find the value of the middle number.
solution:
**Given:**

Average of 7 numbers = 10.8

Average of the first 3 numbers = 10.5

Average of the last 3 numbers = 11.4

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of elements

**Calculation:**

Sum of 7 numbers = 10.8 × 7

⇒ Sum of 7 numbers = 75.6

Sum of the first 3 numbers = 10.5 × 3

⇒ Sum of the first 3 numbers = 31.5

Sum of the last 3 numbers = 11.4 × 3

⇒ Sum of the last 3 numbers = 34.2

Sum of the first 3 numbers + Last 3 numbers + Middle number = Sum of 7 numbers

⇒ 31.5 + 34.2 + Middle number = 75.6

⇒ Middle number = 75.6 - (31.5 + 34.2)

⇒ Middle number = 75.6 - 65.7

⇒ Middle number = 9.9

**The value of the middle number is 9.9.**
